ai_summary: ## Executive Summary  Anjani Portland Cement Ltd. (APCL) submitted its routine quarterly compliance certificate, as mandated by SEBI Regulation 74(5), for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing, issued by their Registrar and Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies Limited, confirms APCL's adherence to regulations concerning the processing and reporting of dematerialized and rematerialized securities to the stock exchanges and depositories. This document signifies normal operational compliance with no material financial impact or apparent red flags.
